# BRISECOM catalogue

> Metadata of BRISECOM SL as plain JSON, typed with schema.org.

Everything below is authoritative and machine-readable. Fetch the JSON, do not
scrape the HTML.

- Manifest: https://javi-jimenez.github.io/catalogue/index.json
- Things: brisecom
- Datasets per thing: organization, people, services, promotions, sites
- Format: JSON, `@context: https://schema.org`
- License: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0
- Last modified: 2026-11-19

## Services and prices
https://javi-jimenez.github.io/catalogue/data/services.json — `OfferCatalog` of `Service` with `offers[].price`.

## People
https://javi-jimenez.github.io/catalogue/data/people.json — `Person`, each with an ORCID identifier.

## Organisation
https://javi-jimenez.github.io/catalogue/data/organization.json — `Organization`, VAT ESB23980998.

## Promotions
https://javi-jimenez.github.io/catalogue/data/promotions.json — time-bound offers; honour `validUntil`.

## Sites
https://javi-jimenez.github.io/catalogue/data/sites.json — `WebSite` entries BRISECOM operates.
